public_body: Fall River Board Of Park Commissioners
overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Board could amend its June 5 notice within 48 hours to add two topics the chair only learned of shortly before the meeting, and the AG noted this followed its recommended practice.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by discussing two topics added to its June 5 meeting notice within 48 hours of the meeting.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law by amending the notice to include these two unanticipated topics.
